editorial:
Imagine being a total loser who just wants to deliver pizzas in peace, only to accidentally eat a super-soldier tomato. That is exactly what happens to Matt Burns. He goes from being a dork to a powerhouse with an indestructible body and crazy strength. The whole vibe is just wild and silly, especially since he ends up fighting bad guys while wearing a giant pizza mascot costume. It is a goofy ride that does not take itself too seriously, making it a perfect pick for a lazy Friday night when you just want to turn your brain off and laugh at some chaos.

While the budget is small, the action is surprisingly fun and the pacing keeps things moving quickly. You will love how ridiculous the fights get, though some of the special effects look a bit cheap. If you enjoy campy superhero stories, you should definitely check this out. You can grab it for a quick rental on Apple TV or add the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection if you love owning quirky gems. It is the kind of movie that is even better when you watch it with a group of friends and some actual pizza.
endingExplained: After a big showdown, Matt uses his super strength and his mascot suit to take down the evil corporate villains who wanted to rule the world. He manages to save the girl and stop the super-soldier science from falling into the wrong hands. The movie wraps up with Matt accepting his new life as a hero. He is still a bit of a dork, but now he is a dork who can punch through walls.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy superheroes and B-movies.
